messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: mężczyzna (formy męskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Pracuje przy utrzymaniu zieleni miejskiej w Zamościu; publikuje rano przed wyjściem do pracy.
- zainteresowania: ostrzenie sekatora, kosiarki spalinowe, kompostowanie liści
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: ławka przy ulicy Peowiaków w Zamościu
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Porządkuje schowek z narzędziami przed sezonem koszenia.
- sposób pisania: zdania: short fragments; interpunkcja: prawie bez znaków; wielkie litery: all lowercase; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: heavy; emoji: no
- tik językowy: kończy wpisy „tyle na dziś”

For each of the 14 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. gry i seriale - wieczór z planszówkami (morning commute, Wednesday)
2. dzieci i rodzina - dziadkowie, telefon (late morning, Sunday)
3. praca i grafik - nadgodziny / wcześniejsze wyjście (afternoon, Monday)
4. pogoda - zmiana pogody vs plany (early morning, Thursday)
5. dzieci i rodzina - rodzeństwo, drobne sprzeczki dzieci (late morning, Sunday)
6. jedzenie i gotowanie - zakupy na obiad, czego zabrakło (lunch break, Saturday)
7. remont i dom - meble do złożenia (lunch break, Wednesday)
8. sport - piłka z kumplami na orliku (late night, Monday)
9. zakupy i ceny - paczkomat, odbiór (lunch break, Thursday)
10. zwierzęta - weterynarz, szczepienie (afternoon, Sunday)
11. praca i grafik - przerwa, kawa, stołówka (early morning, Wednesday)
12. drobne narzekanie na usługi - kurier nie zadzwonił (morning commute, Tuesday)
13. praca i grafik - wypłata, premia, rozliczenie (lunch break, Tuesday)
14. gry i seriale - gra, trudny poziom / boss (early morning, Tuesday)

Return a JSON array of 14 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
